title: Activate default EPS bearer context request

entities.name: Activate default EPS bearer context request
entities.description: Network to UE message used to activate a default EPS bearer context during the attach procedure or to establish a default bearer during UE requested PDN connectivity.

entities.name: Default EPS bearer context activation procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the network to establish a default EPS bearer context for the UE.

entities.name: EPS bearer context
entities.description: Logical packet data connection between UE and PDN gateway providing specific QoS characteristics.

relations.description: The default EPS bearer context activation procedure includes sending the Activate default EPS bearer context request message.
The Activate default EPS bearer context request message establishes a default EPS bearer context.
